unit_goal_source: PR #391, observed-defect repair, no backlog contract (draft perf/opfs-parallel-drain-load-sensitive-threshold deleted in this PR; BASE text read via git show). Observed baseline verified from raw CI logs: main runs 39375394764 (sha 40837803b, job 118473780455) and 39888233973 (sha 8874e47d6, job 120201740981), browser-unit-chromium, tests/browser-unit/opfs-parallel-drain.spec.ts pending-flush overhead gate: 11128.58 > 10846.8 (mkdir 0.9333 vs 0.5583 ms) and 26330.41 > 12012.5 (write 2.9911 vs 2.0243 ms); neighbouring green run 39974798025 (sha 132137bca, job 121017546836) deltas 0.019/0.016 ms, 954.5 <= 9746.1; vfs identical across the three (PD256-ACCEPTANCE lines in /tmp/pr391-review/ci-records.log). BASE 132137bca4a0a706b1a082aa7e63521eaeca4602 (origin/main = merge-base), HEAD c736e31dec02860dd0105a349b99a0ef4a5b5469. Authority: ADR-0358 (epic invariant I3: >=2.5x in the headless browser-unit lane, clean ledger) + the named BASE acceptance spec/worker/helper (git show BASE:tests/browser-unit/opfs-parallel-drain.spec.ts, fixtures/opfs-drain-overhead.ts). PR-4 applied: old criterion (one 200-op window per shape, max(0,single-batched) x population <= 0.1 x faithfulMs) compared against the new one (5 rounds, median of per-round projections, same budget, same populations). Fresh independent reviewer (REV-11), read-only tracked tree, scratch under /tmp/pr391-review. Executed: RED proof BASE helper vs HEAD helper on the exact CI records (/tmp/pr391-review/red-proof.log), committed unit test 12/12 (green-unit.log), four helper mutants min/max/mean/lower-middle each rejected by the committed test (mutants.log), real acceptance spec on this tree: 1 passed 1.3m, speedupRaw 3.0826, 5 rounds, median 169.6 ms <= 3980.9, both trees byte-exact (spec.log, spec-eval.log), biome clean (biome.log), root tsc shows no error in changed files (tsc.log), check:file-size OK, backlog:check OK, refs:check OK. PR CI at HEAD: all lanes green except check:pass-binding (missing landing verdict, REV-8) and browser-unit-chromium pending at review time (pr-checks.log).

findings.evidence: Deleted draft (git show 132137bca:docs/backlog/perf/opfs-parallel-drain-load-sensitive-threshold.md) titled the ratio 'load-sensitive' but its 2026-08-18 sample 'expected <= 12023, got 41786' is a 10%-budget overhead assertion; pr-333-final-green.json:175 (run 34763376182: 14283.6 > 11441.9) and CI36365591064, 39375394764, 39888233973 all failed the same pending-overhead gate. No recorded speedupRaw failure (observed 3.08-3.98 vs 2.625).
findings.summary: Deletion of the draft is justified (hypothesis with no observed defect), but the reference note could state in one clause that every recorded red hit the pending-overhead gate and the speedupRaw gate has no recorded failure, so the former draft's ratio question is closed by evidence, not dropped.
